# kiss-ssg

> A static site generator for Node built to be driven by a coding agent. The package ships its own API contract at node_modules/kiss-ssg/llms.txt; this file indexes the documentation site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/index.md): kiss-ssg lets an AI coding agent – Claude Code or Codex – build a professional website you can host anywhere, or turn a site you made in Claude or ChatGPT into one that keeps its look. Every build is checked before it goes live. Free and open source.
- [Skills](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/skills/index.md): kiss comes in two parts: the kiss-ssg engine, and the skills for Claude Code and Codex that a coding agent follows to build, check, review and remember a site. Each is useful alone; together they make kiss.
- [Examples](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/examples/index.md): Eleven runnable kiss-ssg sites that ship inside the package: whole sites to copy by situation, and short scripts that show one feature each.

## Guide

- [Getting started](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/index.md): How a kiss-ssg site is laid out: starting one, the router.js build script, and the TypeScript types that ship with the package.
- [Converting an existing page](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/converting/index.md): Turning a page you already have — a Claude or ChatGPT artifact, an exported page, a hand-written HTML file — into a structured kiss site that still looks the same.
- [Pages and data](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/pages/index.md): Registering pages with .page() and .pages(), shaping their data with controllers, fetching remote models, and Markdown options.
- [Assets and builds](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/assets/index.md): Copying and compiling assets, cache-busting URLs, running an external asset pipeline, cleaning the build folder, building several sites from one source, and how the dev watcher handles file changes.
- [Sitemap, llms.txt and feeds](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/discovery/index.md): The files crawlers, feed readers and agents read, derived from the same page registry: sitemap.xml and robots.txt for search, an RSS feed, and llms.txt with a Markdown copy of every page for agents.
- [URLs and redirects](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/urls/index.md): Telling kiss where the site is deployed and how its host serves URLs, keeping old addresses alive with redirect files, and letting the host cache hashed files for a year.
- [Learning packages](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/packages/index.md): Zipping pages into IMS content packages and SCORM 1.2 packages for Moodle or any LMS: membership, what a package carries, two ways to build a lesson, and recording answers through the SCORM bridge.
- [Cookie consent](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/consent/index.md): The consent manager built into kiss: services declared once in config.consent, the banner and settings, gated scripts and click-to-load embeds, Google Consent Mode, withdrawal, records of each choice, and what the audit checks.
- [Checking a build](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/checking/index.md): Waiting for a build, dry-running it with kiss-ssg check, reading the report, recording a site's knowledge base with kiss-ssg aikb, and upgrading a site with kiss-ssg upgrade.
- [Helpers](https://cprobert.github.io/kiss-ssg/guide/helpers/index.md): The Handlebars helpers kiss-ssg registers for you, from link and asset to markdown, canonical and isActive, and how to add your own.
